title: A Survey on Contribution Evaluation in Vertical Federated Learning
reasoning: The paper is a technical survey focused on the methods and taxonomies for evaluating data contributions in vertical federated learning systems. While it discusses 'fairness' and 'privacy,' these are treated as game-theoretic and data-security properties (e.g., Shapley values, equitable reward distribution, and regulatory compliance like GDPR) rather than as evaluations of religion, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical philosophies.
